article: Rust eguiと公式eframeテンプレート
scope: Compared the full Japanese article and all twelve translations against current official egui, eframe template, API, and Rust setup references; reviewed terminology, commands, and links.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates, retained original publication date 2023-03-18, set lastmod to review date, and corrected the Japanese rust tag typo.
Clarified the distinction between egui as the GUI library and eframe as its official app framework/integration.
Updated the template clone URL and sample command to match the current upstream getting-started instructions.
Added the official template and API reference links in every language.

post/eguiを使ってみる/index.en.md.summary: Updated the tutorial against current official egui and eframe material, clarified their roles, and refreshed the sample command and links.

meaning.note: Clarified from official egui/eframe documentation that egui is the immediate-mode GUI library and eframe is the app framework/integration for native or web targets.

terminology.note: Checked Rust, egui, immediate mode, eframe, native application, and Cargo terminology across all locales.

mathematics.note: No formulas or calculations appear in this tutorial.
